zh.title: 法國軍方訂購八架空中巴士U050無人機
zh.summary: 法國軍方訂購八架空中巴士U050無人機；海陸軍各獲兩套；預計2027年交付
body: 法國航空維護局（DMAé）已向空中巴士直升機公司下訂四套 U050 Capa-X 無人航空系統，總計包含八架無人機。這項合約於 2026 年 9 月 10 日公布，先前該型無人機已於 2025 年底完成首套系統的陸上與海上評估試驗。
根據規劃，其中兩套系統將分配予法國海軍，另外兩套則分配予法國陸軍，作為輕型戰術無人機系統（SDTL）評估計畫的一部分，預計於 2027 年開始交付。
重約 120 公斤的 U050 Capa-X 具備 7 小時續航力與 100 公里作戰射程，整體配備可由兩輛皮卡貨車載運。首批交付的無人機將配備影像情報（IMINT）光電吊艙與信號情報（SIGINT）功能。

en.title: France Orders Eight Airbus U050 Capa-X Drones for Navy and Army
en.summary: French armed forces order eight Airbus U050 Capa-X drones for evaluation; deliveries set for 2027
body: France's Aeronautical Maintenance Directorate (DMAé) has ordered four U050 Capa-X uncrewed aerial systems from Airbus Helicopters, comprising a total of eight aircraft. Announced on September 10, 2026, the order follows successful land and sea evaluation trials of an initial system acquired in late 2025.
Two systems are allocated to the French Navy and two to the French Army under the Light Tactical Drone System (SDTL) evaluation program, with deliveries scheduled for 2027.

The 120-kilogram U050 Capa-X demonstrated a seven-hour endurance, an operational range of 100 kilometers, and a logistical footprint fitting onto two pickup trucks. In this initial operational configuration, the drones will be equipped with optronic pods for imagery intelligence (IMINT) and signals intelligence (SIGINT) capabilities.

zh.title: 瑞安航空執行長否認乘客被吸出波音737窗戶
zh.summary: 瑞安航空執行長否認乘客被吸出波音737窗戶；稱乘客被吸向窗戶
body: 根據 Simple Flying 於 2026 年 9 月 10 日發布的報導，瑞安航空執行長麥可·歐萊利公開否認有乘客被吸出波音 737 客機窗戶的說法。
歐萊利表示，涉事乘客並非被吸出機艙，而是因壓力差被吸向窗戶方向，隨後機組人員已妥善處理。
該報導未提供進一步調查細節，事件仍屬初步聲明階段。
Simple Flying 的標題為「Ryanair CEO Denies Passenger Was Sucked Out Of Boeing 737 Window」，摘要指出歐萊利堅稱乘客被吸向而非吸出窗戶。

en.title: Ryanair CEO denies passenger was sucked out of Boeing 737 window
en.summary: Ryanair CEO denies passenger sucked out of Boeing 737 window; says passenger sucked toward window
body: According to a Simple Flying article published on 10 September 2026, Ryanair Chief Executive Michael O’Leary denied that a passenger had been sucked out of a Boeing 737 window.
O’Leary stated the passenger was only sucked toward the window because of the pressure differential, and crew handled the situation.
The report provides no further investigation details, and the matter remains at the stage of an initial statement.

Simple Flying’s headline reads “Ryanair CEO Denies Passenger Was Sucked Out Of Boeing 737 Window,” and its summary notes O’Leary insisted the passenger was sucked towards rather than out of the window.

zh.title: Eutelsat向空中巴士追加訂購229顆OneWeb衛星
zh.summary: Eutelsat簽署ATP授權；將增購229顆衛星；總數增至669顆
body: 法國巴黎2026年9月10日電：Eutelsat於巴黎國際太空峰會期間，宣布向空中巴士（Airbus）追加訂購229顆衛星，以強化其OneWeb低軌道（LEO）衛星網路。
Eutelsat已與空中巴士國防與太空部門簽署授權進行書（Authorisation to Proceed，ATP），涵蓋這229顆衛星的初始工業活動。
這些衛星將在空巴位於法國土魯斯的廠房製造。空巴表示，此批衛星是附加於先前已採購、即將交付發射的440顆衛星之外，使空中巴士製造的新OneWeb衛星總數達到669顆。
Eutelsat表示，這批新衛星將確保OneWeb服務的營運延續性，並逐步汰換接近使用壽命末期的早期衛星。

en.title: Eutelsat orders 229 additional OneWeb satellites from Airbus
en.summary: Eutelsat signs ATP with Airbus for 229 more OneWeb satellites; total reaches 669
body: Paris, France, 10 September 2026 – Eutelsat has ordered 229 more satellites from Airbus to strengthen its OneWeb constellation, announced during the International Space Summit in Paris.
Eutelsat has signed an Authorisation to Proceed (ATP) with Airbus Defence and Space covering initial industrial activities for these 229 satellites.

The satellites are planned in addition to the 440 satellites already procured from Airbus, which are due for delivery and launch soon. This brings the total of new OneWeb satellites manufactured by Airbus to 669.

The satellites will be manufactured at Airbus Defence and Space’s Toulouse facility, with the aim of ensuring service continuity of the OneWeb constellation and progressively replacing early batches nearing the end of their operational life.
